host_tests.coverage: Actual broker/cache sources; session isolation, reset before FreeRTOS self-delete, fault/cancel injection, checksum boundaries, cold/warm reads, fresh model shapes, memory guards and destruction order. Hardware probe checks real vendor numerical parity.

limits: Phrase-level output and eight-second minimum segment span remain; no word-by-word captions.
Tiny synthetic fixture set is not a human-speech accuracy benchmark.
Five-minute cache run and prior ten-minute continuous run do not establish infinite endurance.
Camera lazy buffers confound whole-app PSRAM deltas; numeric probe gives exact cache allocation recovery.
Heap guards are snapshots, not reservations; vendor OOM handling and concurrent allocation can still fail.
P4 onboard PDM only; no physical S3, Pi, G2 or display qualification this milestone.
Reported HAL counters are not exhaustive driver-level loss detection.
